title: Reverse the Words
statement:
Read one line of text and print its words in reverse order, separated by single spaces.

Words are separated by one or more spaces. Ignore leading and trailing spaces.

## Input

One line with at least one word.

## Output

The words of the line in reverse order, separated by single spaces.

## Example

Input:

```
the quick brown fox
```

Output:

```
fox brown quick the
```

starter.python-3.14:
line = input()
# Print the words in reverse order
starter.nodejs-24:
const line = require('fs').readFileSync(0, 'utf8');
// Print the words in reverse order
